svg.aria-label: Three authorization models. Role-based access control, RBAC: users get roles such as editor, and roles carry permissions such as edit_post; simple and auditable, but roles multiply. Attribute-based access control, ABAC: a policy evaluates attributes of the user, the resource and the context, for example allow if user.department equals doc.department and the time is within working hours; flexible but harder to audit. Relationship-based access control, ReBAC, as in Google Zanzibar: permissions follow a graph of relationships, for example Asha is a member of team Payments, which is a viewer of folder Q3, which contains doc 42, so Asha can view doc 42.
